# ============================================================
# Fig 1B - dotplot
# ============================================================

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggpubr)
  library(scales)
  library(RColorBrewer)
})

# 1) Load Seurat object
seu <- readRDS("C:/Users/andre/OneDrive - University College London/PhD Year 3/PID paper/Resubmission/RDS objects/newTcells_newPID_version1-TS260825.rds")

# Identity class: make sure this column exists
stopifnot("cell.types" %in% colnames(seu@meta.data))
Idents(seu) <- "cell.types"
seu@meta.data[seu@meta.data$cell.types == "Tk CD8",]$cell.types = "UTC"
seu@meta.data[seu@meta.data$cell.types == "Tem CD8",]$cell.types = "GZMK+ Tem CD8"
seu@meta.data[seu@meta.data$cell.types == "Tm CD8",]$cell.types = "Activated Tem CD8"


# Define gene modules (ordered)
gene_sets <- list(
  "Tcm Treg" = c("RTKN2","PLCL1","TIAM1"),
  "TIL Treg" = c(  
    "FOXP3","BATF","IL2RA","CCR8","CTLA4",
    "TNFRSF4","TNFRSF9","TNFRSF18","ENTPD1","LAYN","GATA3","CD177"
  ),
  "Tfh"           = c("CXCR5","CXCL13","SH2D1A","TOX2"),
  "Th17"          = c("IL17A","IL17F","RORC","KLRB1","CCR6","IL23R"),
  "Progenitor"    = c("SELL","CCR7","TCF7","LEF1","KLF2")
)

module_levels <- c("Progenitor", "Th17", "Tfh", "Tcm Treg", "TIL Treg")

celltype_levels <- c(
  "BATF Treg",
  "Tcm-like Treg",
  "Proliferating",
  "Tfh CD4",
  "Th17 CD4",
  "Progenitor CD4"
)

genes_df <- enframe(gene_sets, name = "module", value = "gene") |>
  unnest(gene) |>
  select(gene, module) |>
  mutate(module = factor(module, levels = module_levels))

gene_levels <- unlist(gene_sets[module_levels], use.names = FALSE)

# Optional safety checks
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(gene_levels))



# 3) Pull expression (data slot) + metadata
DefaultAssay(seu) <- "RNA"

# Keep only genes present in object (prevents subscript errors)
genes_present <- intersect(genes_df$gene, rownames(seu))
genes_missing <- setdiff(genes_df$gene, rownames(seu))
if (length(genes_missing) > 0) {
  message("Missing genes dropped: ", paste(genes_missing, collapse = ", "))
}

# FetchData returns a cell-by-feature data.frame, plus metadata columns you request
df <- FetchData(
  object = seu,
  vars   = c("cell.types", genes_present),
  layer   = "data"
) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("cell.id")

# Restrict to the CD4/Treg/Prolif groups you want
df <- df %>%
  filter(grepl("CD4|Treg|Prolif", cell.types))

# Long format: one row per cell-gene
df_long <- df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = all_of(genes_present),
    names_to  = "gene",
    values_to = "expr"
  )


# 4) Summaries: mean expression + % expressing
summ <- df_long %>%
  group_by(cell.types, gene) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_expr = mean(expr),
    perc_expr = mean(expr > 0) * 100,
    .groups   = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(genes_df %>% filter(gene %in% genes_present), by = "gene")

# Scale mean expression per gene (z-score across cell.types)
summ <- summ %>%
  group_by(gene) %>%
  mutate(scaled_mean_expr = as.numeric(scale(mean_expr))) %>%
  ungroup()

# Apply factors for consistent ordering
summ <- summ %>%
  mutate(
    cell.types = factor(cell.types, levels = celltype_levels),
    module     = factor(module, levels = module_levels),
    gene       = factor(gene, levels = gene_levels)
  )

# 5) Plot
p <- ggplot(summ, aes(x = gene, y = cell.types)) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = scaled_mean_expr, size = perc_expr), shape = 21, colour = "black", stroke = 0) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours = c("darkblue", "#6DCCFF", "lightblue2", "white",
                "lightgoldenrod2", "darkorange1", "red", "firebrick"),
    values = scales::rescale(c(-1.8, -1.2, -0.6, 0, 0.6, 1.2, 1.5, 1.8),
                            from = c(-1.8, 1.8)),
    limits = c(-1.8, 1.8),
    oob = scales::squish
  ) +
  scale_radius(range = c(1, 10)) +
  facet_grid(~module, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev) +
  theme_pubr() +
  theme(
    axis.line        = element_line(colour = "black"),
    panel.background = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "grey", linewidth = 0.2),
    axis.text.x      = element_text(size = 20, colour = "black", angle = 90, hjust=1, vjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.y      = element_text(size = 20, colour = "black"),
    strip.text       = element_text(size = 15, colour = "black"),
    legend.text      = element_text(size = 15, colour = "black"),
    legend.title     = element_text(size = 18, colour = "black")
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL)

p

#ggsave("plots/Dotplot/dotplot2.pdf", plot = p, dpi = 320, width = 12, height = 6)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

md1 <- seu@meta.data

set.seed(1)
md1_plot <- md |> slice_sample(prop = 1)  # random plotting order

centroids <- md1_plot |>

p <- ggplot(md1_plot, aes(x = UMAP_1, y = UMAP_2)) +

    "Tfh CD4" = "plum2",
    "Tm CD8" = "darkgoldenrod1",
    "Trm CD8" = "darkslategrey",

  ))
```

# ============================================================
# Fig 1D - Differential abundance volcano plot
# ============================================================
```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggrepel)
  library(Seurat)
  library(lme4)
  library(lmerTest)  # only needed for lmer section at the end
})

stopifnot(all(c("cell.types", "seq_folder") %in% colnames(seu@meta.data)))

# ----------------------------
# 1) Metadata: define sample_id and pathology (ONE naming convention)
# ----------------------------
md <- seu@meta.data |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("cell_id") |>
  mutate(
    sample_id = case_when(
      seq_folder %in% c("P157_CIS_LT1", "P157_CIS_LT2") ~ "P157_CIS_LT_TP1",
      seq_folder == "P157_LTCIS"                        ~ "P157_CIS_LT_TP2",
      seq_folder %in% c("P155_Normal", "P155_NormRep")  ~ "P155_Normal",
      TRUE                                              ~ seq_folder
    ),
    pathology = if_else(
      sample_id %in% c(
        "P149_CIS","P152_CIS","P153_CIS","P157_CIS_LT_TP1","P157_CIS_LT_TP2",
        "P704_RIB_CIS","P158_RIB_POST_CIS","P158_RUL_CAR_CIS","P158_RUL_ORI_CIS",
        "P159_TR_Abnorm"
      ),
      "CIS", "Normal"
    ),
    pathology = factor(pathology, levels = c("Normal", "CIS"))
  )

# Optional exclusions (as before)
exclude_seq_folder <- c("P153_CIS", "P153_Normal", "P157_MTCIS")
md <- md |> filter(!seq_folder %in% exclude_seq_folder)

# ----------------------------
# 2) Counts per sample x celltype, with totals and explicit zeros
# ----------------------------

# one row per sample with pathology + total cells
sample_tbl <- md |>
  distinct(sample_id, pathology) |>
  # sanity: ensure pathology is unique per sample_id
  group_by(sample_id) |>
  summarise(pathology = dplyr::first(pathology), .groups = "drop") |>
  left_join(md |> dplyr::count(sample_id, name = "n_total"), by = "sample_id")

# all cell types you want to test
celltype_tbl <- md |> dplyr::distinct(cell.types)

# observed counts per (sample, celltype)
counts_obs <- md |>
  dplyr::count(sample_id, cell.types, name = "n_celltype")

# complete grid with zeros
counts_complete <- tidyr::crossing(sample_tbl, celltype_tbl) |>
  left_join(counts_obs, by = c("sample_id", "cell.types")) |>
  mutate(
    n_celltype = ifelse(is.na(n_celltype), 0L, n_celltype),
    prop = n_celltype / n_total
  )

stopifnot(all(c("sample_id","pathology","n_total","cell.types","n_celltype","prop") %in% colnames(counts_complete)))


# ----------------------------
# 3) Effect size: log2FC of mean proportions (CIS/Normal)
# ----------------------------
eps <- 1e-6

mean_props <- counts_complete |>
  group_by(pathology, cell.types) |>
  summarise(mean_prop = mean(prop), .groups = "drop") |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = pathology, values_from = mean_prop) |>
  mutate(
    log2FC = log2((CIS + eps) / (Normal + eps)),
    mean_prop_CIS = CIS
  )


# ----------------------------
# 4) P-values: Welch t-test on sample-level proportions (CIS vs Normal)
# ----------------------------
pvals <- counts_complete |>
  group_by(cell.types) |>
  summarise(
    p_value = t.test(prop ~ pathology)$p.value,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(fdr = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"))

# ----------------------------
# 5) Volcano table for plotting
# ----------------------------
volcano_df <- mean_props |>
  left_join(pvals, by = "cell.types") |>
  mutate(
    neglog10p = -log10(p_value),
    sig = dplyr::if_else(p_value < 0.05, "p < 0.05", "p ≥ 0.05"),
    sig = factor(sig, levels = c("p < 0.05", "p ≥ 0.05"))
  ) |>
  droplevels()

# ----------------------------
# 6) Plot (larger dots; red/black legend only)
# ----------------------------
p <- ggplot(volcano_df, aes(x = log2FC, y = neglog10p)) +
  geom_point(
    aes(size = mean_prop_CIS, fill = sig, colour = sig),
    shape = 21, alpha = 0.9, stroke = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = cell.types),
    size = 6, max.overlaps = 30, force = 20,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("p < 0.05" = "firebrick", "p ≥ 0.05" = "black"),
    breaks = c("p < 0.05", "p ≥ 0.05"),
    labels = c("p < 0.05", "p ≥ 0.05")
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c("p < 0.05" = "black", "p ≥ 0.05" = "black"),
    breaks = c("p < 0.05", "p ≥ 0.05"),
    labels = c("p < 0.05", "p ≥ 0.05")
  ) +
  scale_size(range = c(4, 16)) +
  guides(
    colour = "none",                      # remove duplicate legend
    fill = guide_legend(order = 1),
    size = guide_legend(order = 2)
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-0.1, 0.1), linetype = "dashed", colour = "blue") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1.3, linetype = "dashed", colour = "blue") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 18) +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "black"),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_text(colour = "black", size = 18),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 22),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Log2(FC) of mean proportion (CIS / Normal)",
    y = "-Log10(p)",
    fill = "Significance",
    size = "Mean prop. in CIS"
  )

p

dir.create("plots/Differential_abundance", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
ggsave("plots/Differential_abundance/volcano_CIS_vs_Normal_ttest.pdf",
       plot = p, dpi = 320, width = 8, height = 7, device = grDevices::cairo_pdf)

# ----------------------------
# 7) Which cell types pass FDR < 0.1? (report in legend/methods)
# ----------------------------
volcano_df |>
  mutate(pass_fdr_0.1 = fdr < 0.1) |>
  arrange(p_value) |>
  select(cell.types, log2FC, p_value, fdr, pass_fdr_0.1) |>
  print(n = 50)

```

# ============================================================
# Fig 1E+F - miloR
# ============================================================
```{r}
md <- seu@meta.data %>% 
  mutate(cell.id = row.names(.)) %>% 
  mutate(seq_folder1 = ifelse(seq_folder %in% c("P157_CIS_LT1", "P157_CIS_LT2"), "P157_CIS_LT_TP1",
                              ifelse(seq_folder == "P157_LTCIS", "P157_CIS_LT_TP2",
                                     ifelse(seq_folder %in% c("P155_Normal", "P155_NormRep"), "P155_Normal", seq_folder))),
         final_pathology = ifelse(seq_folder1 %in% c("P149_CIS", "P152_CIS", "P153_CIS", "P157_CIS_LT_TP1", "P157_CIS_LT_TP2", "P704_RIB_CIS", 
                                                     "P158_RIB_POST_CIS", "P158_RUL_CAR_CIS", "P158_RUL_ORI_CIS", "P159_TR_Abnorm"), 
                                  "CIS", "Normal"))

seu@meta.data <- md

cells_to_keep <- seu@meta.data %>% 
  filter(!seq_folder %in% c("P153_CIS", "P153_Normal", "P157_MTCIS")) %>%      # samples to be removed
  pull(cells)

# subset seurat object to only include cells which are from samples we want for downstream analysis
seu1 <- subset(seu, cells = cells_to_keep)
rm(seu)

# create sce & milo objects
DefaultAssay(seu1) <- "integrated"
sce <- as.SingleCellExperiment(seu1)
seu.t_milo <- Milo(sce)
rm(sce)

# now continue with milo analysis
set.seed(1)
seu.t_milo <- buildGraph(seu.t_milo, k = 30, d = 25, reduced.dim = "PCA")

set.seed(1)
seu.t_milo <- makeNhoods(seu.t_milo, prop = 1, k = 30, d=25, refined = TRUE, reduced_dims = "PCA")

# first try running at sample level, instead of joining by patient & merging all 157 together, join by seq_folder1 which has the individual sample ids
colData(seu.t_milo)$sample <- paste0(colData(seu.t_milo)$seq_folder1, "_", colData(seu.t_milo)$final_pathology)
seu.t_milo <- countCells(seu.t_milo, meta.data = as.data.frame(colData(seu.t_milo)), sample="sample")

design <- data.frame(colData(seu.t_milo))[,c("seq_folder1", "final_pathology")]
## Convert info from integers to factor
design$final_pathology <- as.factor(design$final_pathology) 

# simplify data frame to only distinct condition combinations
design <- distinct(design)
rownames(design) <- paste0(design$seq_folder1, "_", design$final_pathology)

set.seed(1)
seu.t_milo <- calcNhoodDistance(seu.t_milo, d=25, reduced.dim = "PCA")

# now work with differential abundance output 
da_results <- testNhoods(seu.t_milo, design = ~ final_pathology, design.df = design)
da_results <- annotateNhoods(seu.t_milo, da_results, coldata_col = "cell.types")
da_results <- annotateNhoods(seu.t_milo, da_results, coldata_col = "final_pathology")

# for arrow annotation, see which condition more neighbourhoods are expressed in
# seriously rinsing dplyr piping here lol
direction <- da_results %>% 
  mutate(enriched = ifelse(logFC < 0 & SpatialFDR < 0.1, "CIS",
                           ifelse(logFC > 0 & SpatialFDR < 0.1, "Normal", NA))) %>% 
  tidyr::drop_na("enriched")

if(length(unique(da_results$enriched)) > 1) {
  direction <- direction %>% 
    group_by(cell.types, enriched) %>% 
    summarise(n=n()) %>% 
    reshape2::dcast(cell.types ~ enriched, value.var = "n") %>% 
    mutate(
      CIS = ifelse(is.na(CIS), 0, CIS),
      Normal = ifelse(is.na(Normal), 0, Normal),
      enriched = ifelse(CIS > Normal, "CIS", "Normal")
    ) %>% 
    mutate(
      start = ifelse(enriched == "CIS", 1, 0),
      end = ifelse(enriched == "CIS", 0, 1),
      direction = ifelse(enriched == "CIS", "Down", "Up")
    ) %>% 
    select(-c(CIS, Normal)) 
} else {
  direction <- direction %>% 
    group_by(cell.types, enriched) %>% 
    summarise(n=n()) %>% 
    reshape2::dcast(cell.types ~ enriched, value.var = "n") %>% 
    mutate(
      CIS = ifelse(is.na(CIS), 0, CIS),
      enriched = "CIS"
    ) %>% 
    mutate(
      start = ifelse(enriched == "CIS", 1, 0),
      end = ifelse(enriched == "CIS", 0, 1),
      direction = ifelse(enriched == "CIS", "Down", "Up")
    ) %>% 
    select(-CIS) 
}

if(length(setdiff(da_results$cell.types, direction$cell.types)) > 0) {
  direction <- direction %>%
    rbind(
      data.frame(
        cell.types = c(setdiff(da_results$cell.types, direction$cell.types)),
        enriched = NA,
        start = NA,
        end = NA,
        direction = NA
      )
    )
} else {
  direction <- direction
}

da_results1 <- da_results %>% 
  mutate(
    new_fc = -logFC,
    cell.types = factor(cell.types, levels = c("BATF Treg", "Tcm-like Treg", "Tfh CD4", "Th17 CD4", "Progenitor CD4",
                                               "Tex CD8", "GZMK+ Tem CD8", "Trm CD8", "UTC", "Activated Tem CD8")))

# now leverage neighbourhood size to 
# create index of neighbourhoods
nhood_index_list <- seu.t_milo@nhoodIndex
# Convert the list into a data frame
nhood_index_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(nhood_index_list), function(i) {
  data.frame(Index = nhood_index_list[[i]], Nhood = i)
}))

# access neighbourhood cells
neighborhoods <- nhoods(seu.t_milo)
# Calculate the size of each neighborhood by summing each column
neighborhood_sizes <- as.data.frame(Matrix::colSums(neighborhoods)) %>% 
  mutate(Index = row.names(.),
         Index = as.numeric(Index)) %>% 
  dplyr::rename(size_nhood = `Matrix::colSums(neighborhoods)`) %>% 
  left_join(nhood_index_df,  by = "Index")

# join with differential abundance for dot sizing
da_results1 <- left_join(da_results1, neighborhood_sizes, by = "Nhood")

pid.bee <- ggplot(mapping=aes(x=cell.types, y=new_fc, size=size_nhood)) +
  geom_quasirandom(data=da_results1[da_results1$SpatialFDR > 0.1,], 
                   alpha=0.8, fill='grey50', pch = 21, color = "black") + 
  geom_quasirandom(data=da_results1[da_results1$SpatialFDR <= 0.1 & da_results1$new_fc < 0,], 
                   #aes(fill=new_fc), 
                   fill = "dodgerblue3", pch = 21, color = "black", alpha=0.8) + 
  geom_quasirandom(data=da_results1[da_results1$SpatialFDR <= 0.1 & da_results1$new_fc > 0,], 
                   #aes(fill=new_fc), 
                   fill = "firebrick", pch = 21, color = "black", alpha=0.8) + 
  coord_flip() +
  facet_grid(cell.types~., scales="free_y", space="free") +
  #scale_fill_gradient2(low='dodgerblue3', mid='grey80', high='firebrick',midpoint=0) +
  #scale_y_continuous(limits=c(-lim.val-eps, lim.val+eps)) +
  scale_radius(range = c(1,15)) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(y=bquote(Log[2](FC))) +
  theme(strip.text.y =  element_text(angle=0, colour='black', size=24, hjust = 0),
        strip.background=element_rect(colour='white', fill='white'),
        axis.title.y = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_blank(), 
        axis.text.x=element_text(size=24, color = "black"), axis.title.x=element_text(size=30, color = "black"),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank()) +
  guides(fill=FALSE)

pid.bee

pid.arrow <- ggplot(direction %>%  mutate(cell.types = factor(cell.types, levels = c("BATF Treg", "Tcm-like Treg", "Tfh CD4", "Th17 CD4", "Progenitor CD4","Tex CD8", "Tem CD8","Trm CD8", "Tk CD8", "Tm CD8"))), 
                    aes(x=cell.types, y=end, xend=cell.types, yend=start, colour=direction)) +
  geom_segment() +
  geom_segment(size=1.2, arrow=arrow(length=unit(0.1, "npc"), type="closed")) +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_colour_manual(values=rev(c('firebrick', 'dodgerblue3')), breaks=c("Up", "Down"),
                      labels=c("Enriched in Normal", "Enriched in CIS")
  ) +
  guides(colour=guide_legend(ncol=1, title="Human PID")) +
  facet_grid(cell.types~., scales="free_y", space="free") +
  theme(strip.text.y = element_blank(), strip.text.x = element_text(angle=90),
        plot.margin = unit(c(0,0,0,0), "cm"), panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.title.x = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_blank(), 
        axis.ticks = element_blank(), axis.text.y=element_blank(),
        axis.title.y=element_blank(), 
        legend.text=element_text(size=20), legend.title=element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom")
pid.arrow

(pid.arrow + pid.bee +
    plot_layout(widths=c(1, 8), guides="collect") & theme(legend.position="top", legend.justification=0))

#ggsave("plots/UMAP_milo/T_cell_miloR.pdf", dpi=320, width = 10, height = 10)


celltype_order <- c(
  "BATF Treg", "Tcm-like Treg", "Tfh CD4", "Th17 CD4", "Progenitor CD4",
  "Tex CD8", "GZMK+ Tem CD8", "Trm CD8", "UTC", "Activated Tem CD8"
)

hg_nhood_summary <- da_results1 |>
  mutate(
    cell.types = factor(cell.types, levels = celltype_order),
    hg_enriched_sig = SpatialFDR <= 0.1 & new_fc > 0
  ) |>
  group_by(cell.types) |>
```

# ============================================================
# Fig 1G - pseudobulk DGE volcano plot
# ============================================================
```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(SingleCellExperiment)
library(glmGamPoi)
library(edgeR)
library(limma)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(SummarizedExperiment)
library(pheatmap)
library(grid)

# ============================================================
# 0. USER SETTINGS
# ============================================================
seu_path <- "/Volumes/T7/Sam Gamble/PID/Code_revisions/July_2025/RDS/newTcells_newPID_version1-TS260825.rds"
output_dir <- "/Users/Petros/Downloads/"

# Gene Lists
target_genes_prog <- c("IRF4", "BATF", "REL", "IL2RA", "CTLA4", "IKZF2", "GATA3", "TNFRSF4", "FOXP3")

genes_of_interest <- c(
  "FOXP3", "IL2RA", "IKZF2", "CTLA4", "TIGIT", "CCR8", "LAYN",
  "BATF", "RTKN2", "TNFRSF18", "TNFRSF4", "ENTPD1", "CD83",
  "NDFIP2", "TOX2", "CSF1", "HPGD", "ACP5", "BTN2A2", "SGPP1",
  "LTBP3", "PARVB", "TCF7", "S1PR1", "NR4A1", "IL7R", "ICOS",
  "PDCD1", "CXCR6", "TNFRSF9"
)

exclude_pattern <- "^(AC[0-9]|AL[0-9]|HIST|TRA|TRB|IGH|IGK|IGL|LINC|HBA|HBB|HBD|HBE1|HBG|HBM|HBQ1|HBZ)"

# Cluster Patterns
broad_cd4_pattern <- "CD4|Treg|Prolif"
treg_pattern <- "Treg"
prog_pattern <- "Progenitor|Prog"

# ============================================================
# 1. HELPER FUNCTIONS
# ============================================================
make_pb <- function(seu_obj, cell_pattern, min_cells_per_pb = 0) {
  cells_use <- colnames(seu_obj)[grepl(cell_pattern, seu_obj$cell.types)]
  if (length(cells_use) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  seu_sub <- subset(seu_obj, cells = cells_use)
  metadata <- seu_sub@meta.data |> as.data.frame()
  
  counts <- GetAssayData(seu_sub, layer = "counts")
  sce <- SingleCellExperiment(assays = list(counts = counts), colData = S4Vectors::DataFrame(metadata))
  
  pb <- glmGamPoi::pseudobulk(sce, group_by = vars(patient, final_pathology))
  pb_meta <- as.data.frame(SummarizedExperiment::colData(pb))
  
  cell_meta <- metadata |>
    dplyr::group_by(patient, final_pathology) |>
    dplyr::summarise(n_cells = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop")
  
  pb_meta <- pb_meta |>
    dplyr::left_join(cell_meta, by = c("patient", "final_pathology")) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      patient = factor(patient),
      final_pathology = factor(final_pathology, levels = c("Normal", "CIS"))
    ) |> droplevels()
  
  rownames(pb_meta) <- colnames(pb)
  pb_counts <- SummarizedExperiment::assay(pb, "counts")[, rownames(pb_meta), drop = FALSE]
  
  list(pb_counts = pb_counts, pb_meta = pb_meta)
}

get_matched_only <- function(pb_counts, pb_meta) {
  matched_patients <- pb_meta |>
    dplyr::distinct(patient, final_pathology) |>
    dplyr::mutate(present = 1L) |>
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = final_pathology, values_from = present, values_fill = 0) |>
    dplyr::filter(Normal == 1, CIS == 1) |>
    dplyr::pull(patient) |> as.character()
  
  pb_meta2 <- pb_meta |> dplyr::filter(patient %in% matched_patients) |> droplevels()
  pb_counts2 <- pb_counts[, rownames(pb_meta2), drop = FALSE]
  list(pb_counts = pb_counts2, pb_meta = pb_meta2)
}

# The "Defensible" Modeling Function
run_limma_voom_defensible <- function(pb_counts, pb_meta, force_keep_genes = NULL) {
  matched <- get_matched_only(pb_counts, pb_meta)
  counts_use <- matched$pb_counts
  meta_use <- matched$pb_meta
  
  dge <- edgeR::DGEList(counts = counts_use)
  design <- stats::model.matrix(~ patient + final_pathology, data = meta_use)
  
  # Logic: Keep genes that pass standard filtering OR are in our target list
  keep_strict <- edgeR::filterByExpr(dge, design = design)
  keep_force <- rownames(dge) %in% force_keep_genes
  dge <- dge[keep_strict | keep_force, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
  dge <- dge[!grepl(exclude_pattern, rownames(dge)), , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
  
  dge <- edgeR::calcNormFactors(dge)
  v <- limma::voom(dge, design, plot = FALSE)
  fit <- limma::lmFit(v, design, weights = meta_use$n_cells)
  fit <- limma::eBayes(fit, robust = TRUE)
  
  res <- limma::topTable(fit, coef = "final_pathologyCIS", number = Inf) |>
    tibble::rownames_to_column("gene") |>
    dplyr::rename(PValue = P.Value, FDR = adj.P.Val)
  
  return(list(res = res, v = v, meta = meta_use))
}

# ============================================================
# 2. LOAD & DECONTAMINATE
# ============================================================
seu <- readRDS(seu_path)
DefaultAssay(seu) <- "RNA"

# Metadata Cleaning
seu@meta.data <- seu@meta.data |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    final_pathology = dplyr::case_when(
      seq_folder %in% c("P149_CIS", "P152_CIS", "P153_CIS", "P704_RIB_CIS", 
                        "P158_RIB_POST_CIS", "P158_RUL_CAR_CIS", "P158_RUL_ORI_CIS", "P159_TR_Abnorm") | 
        grepl("CIS", seq_folder) ~ "CIS",
      TRUE ~ "Normal"
    )
  )

cells_to_keep <- seu@meta.data |>
  dplyr::filter(!seq_folder %in% c("P153_CIS", "P153_Normal", "P157_MTCIS")) |>
  dplyr::pull(cells)
seu1 <- subset(seu, cells = cells_to_keep)

# DecontX
library(celda)
sce <- as.SingleCellExperiment(seu1, assay = "RNA")
sce <- decontX(sce, z = seu1$cell.types)
seu1[["decontX"]] <- CreateAssayObject(counts = round(decontXcounts(sce)))
DefaultAssay(seu1) <- "decontX"
rm(seu, sce)

# ============================================================
# 3. MAIN ANALYSES (BROAD CD4)
# ============================================================
pb_broad <- make_pb(seu1, broad_cd4_pattern)
fit_broad <- run_limma_voom_defensible(pb_broad$pb_counts, pb_broad$pb_meta, genes_of_interest)

# ============================================================
# 7. ADVANCED VOLCANO PLOT (BROAD CD4) with Stringency Gap
# ============================================================
cat("\nGenerating Advanced Volcano Plot for Broad CD4 cells...\n")

# Step 1: Calculate the P-value corresponding to FDR = 0.05
# Find the highest p-value that still satisfies FDR <= 0.05
fdr_05_hits <- fit_broad$res |> dplyr::filter(FDR <= 0.05)
if(nrow(fdr_05_hits) > 0) {
  p_val_fdr_05 <- max(fdr_05_hits$PValue, na.rm = TRUE)
  # Log it just for reference
  cat(paste0("Calculated P-value cutoff for FDR=0.05 is: p = ", round(p_val_fdr_05, 5), "\n"))
} else {
  p_val_fdr_05 <- NA
  cat("Warning: No genes passed FDR < 0.05. The FDR line will not be plotted.\n")
}

# Setting a logFC threshold variable for clarity (consistent with previous plots)
fc_cutoff <- 0.5 

# Step 2: Complex Data Prep - Defining standard vs gap significance
volcano_data <- fit_broad$res |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    # Core logic: classify by direction AND stringency level
    sig = dplyr::case_when(
      # Case A: Strict Significance (FDR < 0.05) - Fully Colored
      FDR < 0.05 & logFC > fc_cutoff  ~ "Up (FDR < 0.05)",
      FDR < 0.05 & logFC < -fc_cutoff ~ "Down (FDR < 0.05)",
      
      # Case B: The "Gap" (P < 0.05, but FDR >= 0.05) - Lighter Shades
      PValue < 0.05 & FDR >= 0.05 & logFC > fc_cutoff  ~ "Up (p < 0.05)",
      PValue < 0.05 & FDR >= 0.05 & logFC < -fc_cutoff ~ "Down (p < 0.05)",
      
      # Case C: Non-significant
      TRUE ~ "Non-significant"
    ),
    
    # Labeling Logic (keeping previous: top hits or genes of interest)
    label_gene = ifelse(gene %in% genes_of_interest | (FDR < 0.001 & abs(logFC) > 1.5), gene, NA)
  ) |>
  # Drop unused categories to keep legend clean
  droplevels()

# Step 3: Create Plot
p_volcano_adv <- ggplot(volcano_data, aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(PValue), color = sig)) +
  # Reference lines (Vertical logFC boundaries)
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-fc_cutoff, fc_cutoff), linetype = "dashed", color = "gray80") +
  
  # --- Horizontal Lines ---
  # 1. P = 0.05 line (Lower, typically gray)
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "gray60") +
  annotate("text", x = 3.5, y = -log10(0.05), label = "p = 0.05 (Nominal)", color = "gray40", vjust = -0.5, size = 3) +
  
  # 2. FDR = 0.05 line (Higher, conditional on hits existing)
  { if(!is.na(p_val_fdr_05)) geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(p_val_fdr_05), linetype = "solid", color = "black", linewidth = 0.4) } +
  { if(!is.na(p_val_fdr_05)) annotate("text", x = 3.5, y = -log10(p_val_fdr_05), label = "FDR = 0.05 (Adjusted)", color = "black", vjust = -0.5, size = 3, fontface = "bold") } +
  
  # Points
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 1.5) +
  
  # Custom Manual Color Palette
  scale_color_manual(
    # Set standard colors and their lighter equivalents
    values = c(
      "Up (FDR < 0.05)"     = "firebrick3",      # Pure red (above FDR)
      "Down (FDR < 0.05)"   = "dodgerblue3",     # Pure blue (above FDR)
      "Up (Nominal Gap)"    = "indianred1",      # Lighter red (between P and FDR)
      "Down (Nominal Gap)"  = "lightskyblue",    # Lighter blue (between P and FDR)
      "Non-significant"     = "gray90"           # Lightest gray for non-DE
    )
  ) +
  
  # Gene Labels with Repel
  geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = label_gene),
    size = 3.2,
    max.overlaps = 30,
    segment.color = "grey50",
    fontface = "italic",
    box.padding = 0.4
  ) +
  
  # Formatting
  labs(
    title = NULL,
    subtitle = NULL,
    x = "log2 Fold Change",
    y = "-log10(P-value)"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.1))) + # Extend top slightly
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_blank(), # Clean legend title
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

# Step 4: Export Plot
volcano_output_path <- paste0(output_dir, "broad_cd4_volcano_gap_colors.pdf")
ggsave(volcano_output_path, p_volcano_adv, width = 9, height = 7)

print(p_volcano_adv)

# ============================================================
# 4. DEFENSIBLE PROGENITOR ANALYSIS
# ============================================================
cat("\n--- Running Defensible Progenitor DGE ---\n")
pb_prog <- make_pb(seu1, prog_pattern)
fit_prog <- run_limma_voom_defensible(pb_prog$pb_counts, pb_prog$pb_meta, target_genes_prog)

# 1. Prepare Table for Console
prog_results_table <- fit_prog$res |>
  dplyr::filter(gene %in% target_genes_prog) |>
  dplyr::select(gene, logFC, PValue, FDR) |>
  dplyr::arrange(desc(logFC))

cat("\n========================================================\n")
cat("   PROGENITOR CD4: TARGET GENE STATS (CIS vs NORMAL)     \n")
cat("========================================================\n")
print.data.frame(prog_results_table, row.names = FALSE, digits = 4)
cat("========================================================\n")

# ============================================================
# 5. HEATMAP GENERATION (Log2FC COLORING)
# ============================================================
cat("\nGenerating Heatmap colored by Model Log2FC...\n")

# Create matrix from model results
heat_mat <- as.matrix(prog_results_table$logFC)
rownames(heat_mat) <- prog_results_table$gene
colnames(heat_mat) <- "Log2FC (High-grade vs Normal)"

# Create p-value labels
p_text <- matrix("", nrow = nrow(heat_mat), ncol = 1)
for(i in 1:nrow(prog_results_table)) {
  p_val <- prog_results_table$PValue[i]
  p_formatted <- format.pval(p_val, digits = 2, eps = 0.001)
  p_text[i, 1] <- paste0("p = ", p_formatted)
}

# Colors and Scale
max_val <- max(abs(heat_mat), na.rm = TRUE)
if(max_val < 1) max_val <- 1
breaks <- seq(-max_val, max_val, length.out = 51)
my_colors <- colorRampPalette(c("dodgerblue3", "white", "firebrick3"))(50)

# Generate Heatmap
p_final <- pheatmap(
  mat = heat_mat,
  color = my_colors,
  breaks = breaks,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  display_numbers = p_text,
  fontsize_number = 9,
  number_color = "black",
  show_colnames = TRUE,
  angle_col = 0,
  main = "Progenitor CD4: Differential Expression (Defensible Model)",
  cellwidth = 150,
  cellheight = 30,
  silent = TRUE
)

# Export and Show
output_path <- paste0(output_dir, "progenitor_cd4_defensible_logFC.pdf")
ggsave(output_path, p_final, width = 6, height = 8)

grid.newpage()
grid.draw(p_final$gtable)

cat(paste0("\nAnalysis complete. Results saved to: ", output_path, "\n"))
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

    !is.na(genes),
    !is.na(logFC),
    !is.na(LR),
    !is.na(PValue),
    !grepl("^(AC[0-9]|AL[0-9]|HIST|TRA|TRB|IGH|IGK|IGL|LINC|HBA|HBB|HBD|HBE1|HBG|HBM|HBQ1|HBZ)", genes)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    rank_metric = sign(logFC) * LR,
    tie_break_1 = abs(logFC),
    tie_break_2 = logCPM
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Collapse duplicated gene symbols explicitly
#    Keep the entry with the largest absolute rank_metric
#    and then strongest abs(logFC), then highest logCPM
# ------------------------------------------------------------
batf_pb_ranked <- batf_pb |>
  group_by(genes) |>
  arrange(desc(abs(rank_metric)), desc(tie_break_1), desc(tie_break_2), .by_group = TRUE) |>
  slice(1) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    rank_metric_final = rank_metric +
      tie_break_1 * 1e-9 +
      tie_break_2 * 1e-12 * sign(rank_metric)
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(rank_metric_final))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Build preranked named vector for fgsea
# ------------------------------------------------------------
geneList <- batf_pb_ranked$rank_metric_final
names(geneList) <- batf_pb_ranked$genes
geneList <- sort(geneList, decreasing = TRUE)

# Optional sanity checks
stopifnot(is.numeric(geneList))
stopifnot(!is.null(names(geneList)))
stopifnot(!any(is.na(geneList)))
stopifnot(!any(duplicated(names(geneList))))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5) Check overlap between pathways and ranked universe
# ------------------------------------------------------------
overlap_df <- tibble(
  pathway = names(gl_list),
  size = lengths(gl_list),
  overlap = purrr::map_int(gl_list, ~ sum(.x %in% names(geneList)))
) |>
  arrange(overlap)

print(overlap_df)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6) Run fgsea
#    nproc = 1 avoids the serialization warnings
# ------------------------------------------------------------
set.seed(1)

res <- fgseaMultilevel(
  pathways = gl_list,
  stats = geneList,
  minSize = 10,
  maxSize = 500,
  nproc = 1
) |>
  as_tibble()

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7) Tidy results for plotting/export
# ------------------------------------------------------------
gsea_res <- res |>
  left_join(overlap_df, by = "pathway") |>
  mutate(
    sig_col = ifelse(padj < 0.05, "padj < 0.05", "padj ≥ 0.05"),
    sig_col = factor(sig_col, levels = c("padj < 0.05", "padj ≥ 0.05")),
    leadingEdgeSize = lengths(leadingEdge)
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(NES))

print(gsea_res)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8) Plot
# ------------------------------------------------------------
library(scales)

plot_df2 <- gsea_res |>
  arrange(desc(NES)) |>
  mutate(
    neglog10_padj = -log10(pmax(padj, 1e-300)),
    fill_plot = ifelse(padj < 0.05, neglog10_padj, 0),
    pathway = factor(pathway, levels = rev(pathway))
  )

sig_min <- min(plot_df2$neglog10_padj[plot_df2$padj < 0.05], na.rm = TRUE)
sig_max <- max(plot_df2$neglog10_padj[plot_df2$padj < 0.05], na.rm = TRUE)

p <- ggplot(plot_df2, aes(x = NES, y = pathway, size = leadingEdgeSize, fill = fill_plot)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2, colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, colour = "black", stroke = 0.4) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours = c("gray80", "mistyrose", "maroon4"),
    values = rescale(c(0, sig_min, sig_max)),
    limits = c(0, sig_max),
    name = expression(-log[10]("adjusted p"))
  ) +
  scale_size(range = c(1.5, 10)) +
  labs(
    x = "NES",
    y = NULL,
    size = "Leading-edge\ngenes"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_line(colour = "black"),
    axis.text = element_text(colour = "black", size = 10),
    axis.title.x = element_text(colour = "black", size = 14),
    legend.text = element_text(colour = "black", size = 11),
    legend.title = element_text(colour = "black", size = 11)
  )

print(p)

#   height = 6,

# )
```

# ============================================================

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(broom)
library(forcats)
library(ggplot2)

# =========================================================
# 1. Load metadata
# =========================================================
md <- read.csv(
  "C:/Users/andre/OneDrive - University College London/PhD Year 3/PID paper/Resubmission/Jan_2025/Jan_2025/Files/Shim_etal_withOtherCD4Subsets-TS291024.csv"
) |>
  dplyr::select(patient, Response, OS_time, Vital_status, TMB, Tumour_type2) |>
  dplyr::rename(patient_id = patient)

# =========================================================
# 2. Load bulk RNA-seq matrix
#    Assumes rows are genes, columns are patients
# =========================================================
mat <- read.csv(
  "C:/Users/andre/OneDrive - University College London/PhD Year 3/PID paper/Resubmission/Jan_2025/Jan_2025/Files/Shim_etal_bulkRNAseq.csv"
)

rownames(mat) <- mat$X
mat1 <- as.matrix(mat[, -1, drop = FALSE])

# =========================================================
# 3. Load pseudobulk gene signatures
# =========================================================
pb_gene_sigs <- readRDS(
  "C:/Users/andre/OneDrive - University College London/PhD Year 3/PID paper/Resubmission/July_2025/July_2025/RDS/pb_gene_sigs_Tcell_260825.rds"
)

pb_gene_sigs <- pb_gene_sigs[c("Progenitor CD4", "Th17 CD4", "BATF Treg", "Tfh CD4", "Tcm-like Treg")]

# =========================================================
# 4. Build filtered top-gene signature lists
# =========================================================
gene.sig.list.pb <- list()

for (i in seq_along(pb_gene_sigs)) {
  
  df <- pb_gene_sigs[[i]] |>
    as.data.frame() |>
    dplyr::filter(logFC > 0.25, PValue < 0.05) |>
    dplyr::filter(!grepl("^AC|CHAIN|^HIST|^HB|^TRA|^TRB|^IGH|^IGL|^IGK|^LINC", genes)) |>
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(logFC)) |>
    dplyr::rename(gene = genes)
  
  df <- df[seq_len(min(300, nrow(df))), , drop = FALSE]
  
  current_sig <- names(pb_gene_sigs)[i]
  gene.sig.list.pb[[current_sig]] <- df
}

# Rename signatures to cleaner names
name_map <- c(
  "Progenitor CD4" = "ProgCD4",
  "Th17 CD4" = "Th17",
  "BATF Treg" = "BATFTreg",
  "Tfh CD4" = "TfhCD4",
  "Tcm-like Treg" = "TcmTreg"
)

names(gene.sig.list.pb) <- unname(name_map[names(gene.sig.list.pb)])

# =========================================================
# 5. Helper function to score a signature per patient
#    Uses geometric mean of positive-expression genes
# =========================================================
score_signature <- function(expr_mat, genes) {
  genes_use <- intersect(genes, rownames(expr_mat))
  
  if (length(genes_use) == 0) {
    return(tibble(patient_id = colnames(expr_mat), score = NA_real_))
  }
  
  score_vec <- apply(expr_mat[genes_use, , drop = FALSE], 2, function(x) {
    x_pos <- x[x > 0]
    if (length(x_pos) == 0) {
      NA_real_
    } else {
      exp(mean(log(x_pos)))
    }
  })
  
  tibble(
    patient_id = names(score_vec),
    score = as.numeric(score_vec)
  )
}

# =========================================================
# 6. Score all signatures
# =========================================================
gene.sig.output <- list()

for (sig_name in names(gene.sig.list.pb)) {
  genes <- gene.sig.list.pb[[sig_name]]$gene
  
  sig_df <- score_signature(expr_mat = mat1, genes = genes) |>
    dplyr::rename(!!sig_name := score)
  
  gene.sig.output[[sig_name]] <- sig_df
}

# Add simple CD8 and CD4 infiltration proxies
cd8_df <- score_signature(
  expr_mat = mat1,
  genes = c("CD8A", "CD8B", "CD3D", "CD3E", "CD3G")
) |>
  dplyr::rename(cd8 = score)

cd4_df <- score_signature(
  expr_mat = mat1,
  genes = c("CD4", "CD3D", "CD3E", "CD3G")
) |>
  dplyr::rename(cd4 = score)

gene.sig.output[["cd8"]] <- cd8_df
gene.sig.output[["cd4"]] <- cd4_df

# =========================================================
# 7. Merge all signature scores with metadata
# =========================================================
gene.sig.df <- purrr::reduce(gene.sig.output, dplyr::full_join, by = "patient_id") |>
  dplyr::left_join(md, by = "patient_id") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    event = ifelse(Response == "response", 1, 0)
  )

# =========================================================
# 8. Dichotomise variables at cohort median
# =========================================================
gene.sig.df <- gene.sig.df |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    BATFTreg_cat = factor(
      ifelse(BATFTreg > median(BATFTreg, na.rm = TRUE), "high", "low"),
      levels = c("low", "high")
    ),
    cd8_cat = factor(
      ifelse(cd8 > median(cd8, na.rm = TRUE), "high", "low"),
      levels = c("low", "high")
    ),
    cd4_cat = factor(
      ifelse(cd4 > median(cd4, na.rm = TRUE), "high", "low"),
      levels = c("low", "high")
    ),
    tmb_cat = factor(
      ifelse(TMB > median(TMB, na.rm = TRUE), "high", "low"),
      levels = c("low", "high")
    )
  )

# Optional: inspect cohort size after complete-case filtering
analysis_df_cd8 <- gene.sig.df |>
  dplyr::select(patient_id, event, BATFTreg_cat, cd8_cat, tmb_cat) |>
  tidyr::drop_na()

analysis_df_cd4 <- gene.sig.df |>
  dplyr::select(patient_id, event, BATFTreg_cat, cd4_cat, tmb_cat) |>
  tidyr::drop_na()

cat("N for BATFTreg + CD8 + TMB model:", nrow(analysis_df_cd8), "\n")
cat("N for BATFTreg + CD4 + TMB model:", nrow(analysis_df_cd4), "\n")

# =========================================================
# 9. Fit multivariable logistic regression models
# =========================================================
mod_cd4_cd8 <- glm(
  event ~ BATFTreg_cat + cd8_cat + cd4_cat + tmb_cat,
  data = gene.sig.df |>
    dplyr::select(patient_id, event, BATFTreg_cat, cd8_cat, cd4_cat, tmb_cat) |>
    tidyr::drop_na(),
  family = binomial(link = "logit")
)

# =========================================================
# 10. Helper to extract OR, CI, and p values
# =========================================================
extract_or_table <- function(model) {
  broom::tidy(model) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      OR = exp(estimate),
      Lower_CI = exp(estimate - 1.96 * std.error),
      Upper_CI = exp(estimate + 1.96 * std.error)
    ) |>
    dplyr::rename(
      P_Value = p.value
    ) |>
    dplyr::select(term, estimate, std.error, OR, Lower_CI, Upper_CI, P_Value)
}

res_cd4_cd8 <- extract_or_table(mod_cd4_cd8)
res_cd4_cd8

# =========================================================
# 11. Pull out BATFTreg result for sentence-writing
# =========================================================
batf_cd4_cd8 <- res_cd4_cd8 |>
  dplyr::filter(term == "BATFTreg_cathigh")

format_num <- function(x, digits = 2) {
  formatC(x, format = "f", digits = digits)
}

format_p <- function(p) {
  if (is.na(p)) {
    NA_character_
  } else if (p < 0.001) {
    formatC(p, format = "e", digits = 2)
  } else {
    formatC(p, format = "f", digits = 3)
  }
}

cat(
  "CD4+CD8-adjusted BATFTreg result: OR = ",
  format_num(batf_cd4_cd8$OR),
  ", 95% CI ",
  format_num(batf_cd4_cd8$Lower_CI),
  " - ",
  format_num(batf_cd4_cd8$Upper_CI),
  ", p = ",
  format_p(batf_cd4_cd8$P_Value),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)

# =========================================================
# 12. Forest plot for one chosen model
# =========================================================
# =========================================================
# 12. Forest plot for CD4 + CD8-adjusted model
# =========================================================
plot_df <- res_cd4_cd8 |>
  dplyr::filter(term != "(Intercept)") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    term = dplyr::recode(
      term,
      "BATFTreg_cathigh" = "BATF+ Treg high",
      "cd8_cathigh" = "CD8 high",
      "cd4_cathigh" = "CD4 high",
      "tmb_cathigh" = "TMB high"
    ),
    term = factor(
      term,
      levels = rev(c("BATF+ Treg high", "CD8 high", "CD4 high", "TMB high"))
    ),
    sig = ifelse(P_Value < 0.05, "p < 0.05", "p ≥ 0.05"),
    ci_label = paste0(
      "OR ", format_num(OR), " [",
      format_num(Lower_CI), " - ",
      format_num(Upper_CI), "]"
    )
  )

ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = term, y = OR, fill = sig)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Lower_CI, ymax = Upper_CI), width = 0.15) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, size = 5, colour = "black") +
  geom_text(aes(label = ci_label), hjust = 0.5, vjust = -1, size = 4) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("p < 0.05" = "firebrick", "p ≥ 0.05" = "black")) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14, colour = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11, colour = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, colour = "black"),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.title = element_blank()
  ) +
  labs(y = "Odds ratio of anti-PD-1 response")
```
